privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: {operator} (“we”, “us”, or “our”) provides the {appName} web application (the “Service”). {platformLine} This page informs you of our policies regarding the collection, use, and disclosure of personal data when you use the Service.
privacy.collect.heading: Information We Collect
privacy.collect.lead: We collect the following types of information:
privacy.collect.account: {term} Your name, email address, and profile photo when you create an account or sign in.
privacy.collect.phone: {term} If you choose to provide your phone number for SMS scheduling notifications.
privacy.collect.musicianProfile: {term} Your instrument preference, transposition settings, and scheduling availability.
privacy.collect.usage: {term} Information about how you use the Service, including pages visited and features used.
privacy.use.heading: How We Use Your Information
privacy.use.notifications: Send scheduling notifications via email, SMS, and push notifications
privacy.use.coordination: Facilitate musician coordination and setlist management
privacy.sms.heading: SMS / Mobile Messaging
privacy.sms.optIn: If you opt in to receive SMS notifications, we will send you text messages related to your scheduling assignments, reminders, and cancellations at {operator}.
privacy.sms.mobileInfoNotShared: Mobile information, including phone numbers, will not be shared with third parties for marketing or promotional purposes. Mobile information will only be shared with third parties as necessary to deliver the SMS messaging service (i.e., our SMS delivery provider, Twilio).
privacy.sms.frequencyAndOptOut: Message frequency varies based on your scheduling activity. Message and data rates may apply. You may opt out of SMS notifications at any time through your profile settings or by replying STOP to any message.
privacy.sharing.heading: Data Sharing
privacy.sharing.lead: We do not sell, trade, or rent your personal information to third parties. We share information only in the following circumstances:
privacy.sharing.providers: {term} We use trusted third-party services (Firebase, Resend, Twilio) to operate the Service. These providers only have access to information necessary to perform their functions.
privacy.sharing.withinOperator: {term} Band leaders and administrators may see your scheduling availability and contact information to coordinate services.
privacy.sharing.legal: {term} We may disclose information if required by law.
privacy.security.heading: Data Security
privacy.security.body: We use industry-standard security measures to protect your data, including encrypted connections (HTTPS), Firebase Authentication, and role-based access controls. However, no method of transmission over the Internet is 100% secure.
privacy.retention.heading: Data Retention
privacy.retention.body: We retain your personal data only for as long as you maintain an account with the Service. You may request deletion of your account and associated data by contacting us.
privacy.rights.heading: Your Rights
privacy.rights.access: Access the personal information we hold about you
privacy.rights.deletion: Request deletion of your account and data
privacy.rights.optOutSms: Opt out of SMS notifications at any time
privacy.rights.optOutEmail: Opt out of email notifications at any time
privacy.children.heading: Children's Privacy
privacy.children.body: The Service is not intended for use by anyone under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13.
privacy.changes.heading: Changes to This Policy
privacy.changes.body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new Privacy Policy on this page and updating the “Last updated” date.
privacy.contact.heading: Contact Us
privacy.contact.body: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact {operator} at {email}.

terms.description.heading: 2. Description of Service
terms.description.lead: {appName} is a musician coordination tool for {operator} that provides:

terms.accounts.body: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account. You agree to provide accurate information when creating your account. {operator} administrators manage user roles and access levels.
terms.sms.heading: 4. SMS Messaging Terms
terms.sms.lead: By opting in to SMS notifications through the Service, you agree to:
terms.sms.receive: Receive text messages related to your scheduling assignments at {operator}
terms.sms.types: Message types include: assignment notifications, reminders, confirmations, and cancellations
terms.sms.frequency: Message frequency varies based on your scheduling activity

terms.liability.body: {operator} shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages arising from your use of the Service.

terms.contact.heading: 10. Contact

sms.title: SMS Messaging Consent & Opt-In
sms.subtitle: {operator} — {appName}
sms.highlight.heading: How SMS Opt-In Works
sms.highlight.intro: {appName} musicians may opt in to receive SMS scheduling notifications by providing their phone number and enabling SMS notifications in their profile settings within the {appName} application.
sms.highlight.optInVoluntary: Opt-in is {voluntary} and {notRequired} to use the {appName} application. Musicians can use email and in-app notifications instead.
sms.program.heading: Program Description
sms.program.lead: {operator} provides the {appName} application, which includes an optional SMS notification service for musician scheduling. {platformLine} When musicians opt in, they receive text messages about:
sms.program.assignments: {term} Notification when you're assigned to play at a service
sms.program.reminders: {term} Service reminders 48 hours before your scheduled performance
sms.program.confirmations: {term} Confirmation when you accept or decline an assignment
sms.program.cancellations: {term} Notification if a service or your assignment is cancelled
sms.program.changes: {term} Updates to services you're assigned to
sms.consent.heading: Consent Process
sms.consent.lead: Musicians provide consent to receive SMS messages through the following process:
sms.consent.stepSignIn: Sign in to the {appName} application at {web}
sms.consent.stepPhone: Enter your phone number in the Phone Number field
sms.consent.stepToggle: Toggle the {switchLabel} notification switch to ON
sms.consent.affirm: By completing these steps, the musician affirmatively consents to receive SMS messages from {appName} at the phone number provided.
sms.frequency.heading: Message Frequency
sms.frequency.body: Message frequency varies based on how often the musician is scheduled for services. Typical musicians receive 2-8 messages per month. Messages are only sent in relation to your specific scheduling activity.
sms.rates.heading: Message and Data Rates
sms.rates.body: Standard message and data rates may apply depending on your mobile carrier and plan. {operator} does not charge for SMS messages sent through the Service.
sms.optOut.heading: Opt-Out
sms.optOut.lead: You may opt out of SMS messages at any time by:
sms.optOut.replyStop: Replying {stopKeyword} to any message received from {appName}
sms.optOut.disableToggle: Disabling the SMS toggle in your {appName} profile settings
sms.optOut.removePhone: Removing your phone number from your profile settings
sms.optOut.after: After opting out, you will receive one final confirmation message. You will no longer receive SMS messages from {appName} unless you opt in again.
sms.help.heading: Help
sms.help.body: For help with SMS notifications, reply {helpKeyword} to any message or contact us at {email}.
sms.privacy.heading: Data Privacy
sms.privacy.mobileInfoNotShared: Mobile information, including phone numbers, will not be shared with third parties for marketing or promotional purposes.
sms.privacy.body: Phone numbers are stored securely and used solely for delivering scheduling-related SMS messages through our messaging provider (Twilio). See our full {privacyLink} for details on how we handle your data.
sms.contact.heading: Contact Information
sms.related.heading: Related Policies
accessibility.title: Accessibility Statement
accessibility.intro: {operator} is committed to making the {appName} web application accessible to everyone who uses it. {platformLine} We aim to meet or exceed the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1 Level AA across the app.
accessibility.doing.heading: What we're doing
accessibility.doing.landmarks: Semantic HTML landmarks ({mainTag}, {navTag}, headings) on every route.
accessibility.doing.accessibleNames: Accessible names on all icon-only buttons ({ariaLabel}) and form fields ({labelTag} or {ariaLabel}, never placeholder-as-label).
accessibility.doing.contrast: WCAG 2.1 AA contrast on body text and interactive surfaces.
accessibility.doing.pinchZoom: Pinch-zoom and user-scaling preserved on mobile (no {maxScale} viewport lock).
accessibility.doing.skipLink: Skip-link to main content on app-shell routes.
accessibility.doing.keyboard: Keyboard support in Perform mode (chart navigation, transpose, metronome) and live regions for setlist mutations.
accessibility.doing.axe: Automated axe-core sweeps run as part of our audit cadence.
accessibility.limitations.heading: Known limitations
accessibility.limitations.body: We track open accessibility findings on every release cycle. The PDF-render surface inside Perform mode is the area where assistive-technology support is most limited today; we're working to surface chart structure (sections, key, capo) outside the rendered image where possible.
accessibility.report.heading: Report a barrier
accessibility.report.body: If you encounter a part of the app you can't use with your assistive technology, please email {email}. Include the page URL and a short description; we'll respond within a week.
